title: v3b VLM non-convergence diagnosis: collocation-placement defect, corrected lattice, camber effect
does_not_establish: No fin load, flight or biological claim: an inviscid thin-surface lattice-convergence diagnosis of three designed fin geometries; no body, viscosity or separation.

results.diagnosis: vlm.lattice places each collocation point on the polygon chord at mid-span (cm) while bound vortices use the panel-edge chords; on curved outlines the point leaves its panel (up to ~2 chords upstream at nc=24). Errors grow with chordwise refinement, so CL drifts with nc for every variant; v3b's diagonal ladder looked worst because its cambered (glide-pose) normals add an alpha-independent term that the misplaced points sample differently at each lattice.

control: pose decomposition of planar v3a gives |slope| < 1e-3 deg and |camber/chord| < 1e-4 (input stored to 1e-7 m)
control: flat-normal arms give CL(alpha=0) = 0 exactly (no camber)
control: committed VLM analytic controls (elliptic AR6/AR20, camber, symmetry) all pass in the record
